info.title: Loggi API
info.description:
Logistics management: warehouses and stock, commodities, delivery orders and their tracking, fleet and drivers, administrators and audit logs.

Every response is wrapped in an envelope of the shape `{ code, status, msg, data }`, where `code` repeats the HTTP status. `204 No Content` is the one exception and carries no body at all.

All endpoints require a bearer token except those under `/api/admin/login`, `/api/admin/init`, `/api/admin/hasInit` and `/api/admin/verification-code`, which have to work before a token exists.

tags.name: Commodities
tags.description: The catalogue of goods this system moves.

tags.name: Sales (API only)
tags.description: No client calls these. The screens were never built, and after S10 that is a decision rather than an omission: the endpoints are documented here and left in place, because the domain is real and the API is the deliverable. See the backend README.

tags.name: Employees (API only)
tags.description: No client calls these, for the same reason as Sales. Documented and kept deliberately; see the backend README.

tags.name: Audit logs
tags.description: Who did what, and who tried to sign in. Both are paginated.

tags.name: Administrators
tags.description: Accounts, authentication and the first-run bootstrap.

tags.name: Delivery orders
tags.description: Orders, the fleet available to carry them, and their tracking trail.

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description: Stock levels per warehouse, and the movements that change them.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: The roles an administrator can be granted.
